content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose significant fees and restrictions, alienating creators in regions facing financial isolation. For instance, Gumroad takes a 10% commission on every sale, while COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%. This difference means substantial savings; with just 100 sales a month on a $97 product, you would retain an additional $921. By leveraging decentralized crypto payment solutions, you regain full ownership and control over your income, ensuring that your hard work translates directly into profit.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start selling digital products, you need a clear understanding of your offerings and the tools at your disposal. Identify the type of digital products you wish to sell—be it ebooks, courses, or templates. You will also need to set up a basic infrastructure, which includes hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a payment processor like NOWPayments, and a delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This infrastructure will empower you to operate independently and efficiently, circumventing the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying your chosen stack from COREMERCH. For a quick setup, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack, which integrates GitHub Pages with Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. This configuration allows you to automate payment processing and digital product delivery. Set up your product listings and ensure that NOWPayments is configured to handle crypto transactions. By utilizing automated scripts, you guarantee instant delivery of your products upon successful payment, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, allowing you to retain more revenue.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed and tested, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital products through social media, email marketing, or relevant forums. Direct potential customers to your store link, ensuring they understand the benefits of paying with crypto. Monitor your transactions closely as they come in, and confirm that the NOWPayments integration is functioning correctly. The moment a customer completes a purchase, they should receive immediate access to their product, streamlining their experience and solidifying your reputation as a reliable seller.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your sales grow, consider scaling your operations by expanding your product offerings and optimizing your infrastructure. Use the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced performance, integrating additional features like Supabase for better order management. Analyze customer feedback and transaction data to refine your offerings. With the Complete Builder Kit, you gain access to all necessary blueprints and templates, enabling you to build, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack effectively, ensuring sustained growth and profitability.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a decentralized payment processor like NOWPayments. This solution allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly, enabling secure transactions without the high fees associated with traditional platforms. By setting up your digital store on a platform like GitHub Pages, you can maintain control over your sales and customer data.
Automate product delivery to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline operations.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in building a comprehensive digital commerce infrastructure, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all six blueprints and seven templates you need to establish a thriving online store. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to take advantage of this all-in-one solution.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilize decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments, which charge only 0.5% per transaction. This significantly reduces fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, allowing you to keep more of your earnings while providing a seamless purchasing experience for your customers.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by setting up your own store using COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers. This approach eliminates dependence on restrictive platforms and allows you to retain full ownership of your products and sales operations.
What is the best way to handle automated delivery?

Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your digital products. These tools ensure that customers receive their purchases instantly upon successful payment, enhancing their experience and increasing the likelihood of repeat business.
How do I ensure security in my transactions?

Utilize NOWPayments to process all transactions securely, with no KYC requirements. Additionally, ensure that your hosting and storage solutions are secure and that you regularly update your infrastructure to protect against vulnerabilities.
Is it difficult to set up my own digital store?

Not at all. With COREMERCH's structured blueprints and templates, you can set up your digital store quickly and efficiently. Follow the step-by-step deployment guide, and you’ll have your store operational in no time.
Complete ownership means you control your business without reliance on third-party platforms.
